review_candidates.title: Contrl Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Day-to-day responsibilities include monitoring, maintaining, and troubleshooting control and instrumentation systems to ensure safe and efficient operation of equipment and processes. Qualifications Strong foundation in control engineering, automation, and instrumentation, with the ability to analyze and optimize process control systems. Experience with industrial control hardware and software (e.g., PLCs, DCS, SCADA), including configuration, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
eligibility_evidence: Role Description The Control Engineer will work on-site in Alexandria in a full-time capacity, supporting control systems for petroleum sector facilities.
Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams and on-site environments.
